errors.not_found: The file was not found. It may have been moved or deleted.
errors.store: The app's database could not be read or written.
errors.io: The file could not be read or written.
errors.file_too_large: The file is too large to open.
errors.invalid_file: This is not a valid KataBox Arch design file.
errors.newer_file_schema: This design was saved by a newer version of KataBox Arch. Update the app to open it.

errors.internal: Something went wrong inside the app.
errors.no_path: No request can get through this design. Connect a client to a service.

unsaved.title: Save your changes?
unsaved.body: “{{name}}” has changes that aren't saved. They will be lost if you don't save them.

canvas.label: Canvas
canvas.statPending: Live stats arrive with the simulation
canvas.snapHint: Cards snap to an 8 px grid. Hold Alt while dragging to place freely.

reason.self_loop: A component can't connect to itself.
reason.duplicate_edge: These two are already connected with every protocol they allow.
reason.into_client: Clients only start requests; nothing calls into a client.
reason.client_to_data: A client can't reach a data store directly. Put a service in between.
reason.data_calls_out: Data stores answer queries; they don't start calls.
reason.consume_needs_compute: Messages leave a queue or stream only through a consumer service.
reason.edge_to_data: Put a service between the edge and the data.

keyboard.start: Connecting from {{name}}. Pick a target with the arrow keys or Tab, then press Enter. Escape cancels.
keyboard.hint: Arrows or Tab: pick a target · Enter: connect · Esc: cancel

library.title: Library
library.add: {{name}}: drag onto the canvas or press Enter to add
library.guideLater: The full Component Guide entry (what it does, when to use it, its numbers) arrives in M3.

inspector.title: Inspect
inspector.label: Label
inspector.ballparkHint: A calibrated default: a conservative ballpark whose source is still being confirmed.
inspector.citedHint: A calibrated default taken from a cited source.
inspector.calibrationNote: Tagged defaults are calibrated figures (see docs/calibration.md). The others are design choices for you to set.
inspector.zoneHint: Cards inside a zone move with it. Network latency between zones arrives with the simulation.
inspector.nothingSelected: Select a card, a connection or a zone to edit it.
inspector.rangeInt: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
inspector.autoscaleHint: Compute cards inside this frame scale between the minimum and maximum instances, adding instances when utilisation stays above the target.

home.title: Design it. Break it. Fix it.
home.noRecent: No designs yet. Start a new one, or open a .kbarch file.

problems.title: Problems arrive in M2
problems.body: A LeetCode-style list of system design challenges, each judged against hidden traffic tests.

guide.body: An entry and a concept card for every component: what it does, when to use it, and its numbers.

samples.title: Animated samples arrive in M3
samples.body: Five guided designs that show traffic flowing, breaking and recovering.

progress.title: Nothing to show yet

settings.contrastHint: High contrast uses stronger text, borders and focus rings.

metrics.empty: Run the design to see live metrics.
